dialect.detail: JMA ORCA medical receipt system (JMA standard receipt software), compiled with GnuCOBOL/OpenCOBOL on Linux. Program ORCR0640 handles inpatient diagnosis-category point aggregation.
evidence: NACL- author prefixes typical of ORCA project
no EXEC CICS/SQL, no COMP-3, fixed format consistent with GnuCOBOL ORCA codebase

purpose.domain_detail: Japanese medical insurance receipt (レセプト) processing system for inpatient claims; specifically point aggregation by diagnosis category (診療区分別点数集計) for hospitalization receipts
purpose.summary: ORCR0640 is a large batch program in the JMA ORCA open-source medical receipt software suite. It aggregates and edits diagnosis-category point scores for inpatient (入院) insurance claim receipts, handling co-payment calculations, public expense (公費) processing, and various regional/special fee rules across many revision cycles from 2002 onward.

notable_features: Very large single program: 32,613 lines, ~1.57 MB
55 COPY statements indicating heavy use of shared copybooks
1,400 PERFORM statements indicating complex structured logic
No EXEC SQL or EXEC CICS (flat-file/indexed file based)
No COMP-3 usage (unusual for financial COBOL; uses display numerics)
Extensive Japanese-language comments in EUC-JP encoding (decoded as latin-1)
Long revision history spanning 2002–2007+ with named NACL developers
Fixed source format with lines up to 80 chars
verdict.notes: File decoded with latin-1 but comments are actually EUC-JP encoded Japanese text (garbled in the excerpt). This is definitively part of the JMA ORCA open-source medical receipt system, a well-known GnuCOBOL-based production system used by Japanese medical clinics. The file is extremely large (32k lines) and represents mature production code with a detailed multi-year change history.
